Available on back-order Freya Overdrive/Booster quantity Add to basket Share this product Categories: Booster / Pre-amp , Overdrive , Pedals Tags: booster , Effects , guitar gear , guitar pedals , overdrive , Pedals , sitek , sitek pedals , stompbox Previous Product Next Product Description Additional information Controls Videos Warranty Description Meet Freya, a goddess of beauty and war – both captivating and powerful. Freya is a combo of a low to mid-gain overdrive and a transparent high headroom booster. Both sections can operate independently and their order is easily switchable for even more tonal options. Freya internally converts the standard 9V DC power to +/-9V DC to gain more headroom to operate. The pedal uses high quality JFET operational amplifiers for higher input impedance, lower noise, great signal integrity and clarity. Top-mounted jacks and compact footprint make it suitable for any pedalboard. Freya’s overdrive section was designed to provide a focused mid-push with three distinctive clipping voices, a vast amount of headroom with great clarity of bottom and top-end of the signal. It’s smooth on the clean channel and tightening things up on the dirty channel. The clipping switch allows you to choose from smooth, bluesy breakup, open and focused boost to push the front-end of your dirty channel and mid-rich lead tone. The pedal also includes a full range, transparent booster section providing up to 12dB of clean boost. You can use the boost alone, boost the volume of already overdriven signal to push the tube amp even harder or provide an additional source of gain to the overdrive part of Freya for that fuzzy bottom end by switching the order of the sections. Freya is an all-analog circuit, designed on carefully selected gain and clipping stages. It is built with high grade components for best signal quality. Additional information Weight 0.35 kg Dimensions 12 × 7.7 × 6 cm Controls Smooth-Click™ Footswitches : The pedal is equipped with two DeMont Smooth-Click footswitches – the highest quality footswitches on the market – and provides True Bypass operation for both Overdrive and Boost section. Press DRIVE button to engage overdrive section Press BOOST button to engage boost section Level : Controls the output volume of the overdrive section. Drive : Controls the amount of overdrive. Tone : Modifies the frequency content of the signal. Turn counter-clockwise for more bass Keep center for more mids Turn clockwise for more treble Boost : Controls the output volume of the boost section. Turn fully counter-clockwise for unity gain (boost operates as a signal buffer) Turn clockwise to increase the output volume up to +12dB. 3-way Clipping Switch : Selects one of the clipping modes in the overdrive section: II – for smooth and rounded lead tone Off – disables the clipping diodes providing the cleanest, the loudest and the most dynamic output signal I – provides a good amount of crunchy midrange, cutting well through the mix Drive First / Boost First Switch: Determines the order of overdrive and boost sections when both are engaged. Within 5 year the repair will be done free of charge excluding shipping fee. This warranty does not include misuse or accidents resulting in damage. sources.excerpt: Sitek Guitar Electronics Announces the Freya Overdrive/Booster Freya’s overdrive section was designed to provide a focused mid-push with three distinctive clipping voices, a vast amount of headroom with great clarity of bottom and top-end of the signal. Bass Magazine / Aug 5, 2020 Sitek Guitar Electronics Announces the Freya Overdrive/Booster Freya’s overdrive section was designed to provide a focused mid-push with three distinctive clipping voices, a vast amount of headroom with great clarity of bottom and top-end of the signal. Bass Magazine / Aug 5, 2020 Sitek Guitar Electronics has just released their first dual pedal – designed in collaboration with Joss Allen, a YouTube guitarist known for his heavy-metal magic. The Freya is designed around Joss’s amazing style and technique. This versatile dual pedal is a combo of a low to mid-gain overdrive and a transparent high headroom booster. Freya’s overdrive section was designed to provide a focused mid-push with three distinctive clipping voices, a vast amount of headroom with great clarity of bottom and top-end of the signal. It’s smooth on the clean channel and tightening things up on the dirty channel. Users may choose between 3 clipping options from smooth, bluesy breakup, open and focused boost to push the front-end of a dirty channel and mid-rich lead tone. The pedal also includes a full range, transparent booster section providing up to 12dB of clean boost. Both sections can operate independently and their order is easily switchable for even more tonal options. Features: 5 simple controls: Level, Tone, Drive, Boost and a 3-way clipping switch Switchable order of Boost and Overdrive High quaity DeMont Smooth-Click Footswitches Powdercoated enclosure to withstand tough stage conditions Reverse polarity protection True Bypass Power supply 9V DC or 9V battery Top-mounted jacks Compact footprint Freya Overdrive/Booster is available to purchase on Reverb.com or directly from the Sitek Guitar Electronics website and carries a price of $240.
